servers.name: gbif
servers.description: GBIF MCP server for taxonomic lookup, global occurrence records, dataset discovery, maps, and literature citing GBIF data.

tools.name: gbif_species_search
tools.description: Search for taxa and taxonomic concepts with advanced filters.

tools.name: gbif_species_match
tools.description: Match scientific names against GBIF taxonomy.

tools.name: gbif_species_synonyms
tools.description: Inspect synonyms and alternative names for a taxon.

tools.name: gbif_occurrence_search
tools.description: Search occurrence records with extensive geographic, temporal, and dataset filters.

tools.name: gbif_occurrence_count
tools.description: Count matching occurrence records without downloading full results.

tools.name: gbif_occurrence_get
tools.description: Fetch complete metadata for a single occurrence.

tools.name: gbif_dataset_search
tools.description: Search published biodiversity datasets and their sources.

servers.name: stac
servers.description: STAC MCP server for discovering Earth-observation collections, assets, and spatiotemporal items across STAC catalogs.

tools.name: get_root
tools.description: Fetch root metadata for a target STAC catalog.

tools.name: get_conformance
tools.description: Inspect STAC conformance classes or verify specific URIs.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a STAC collection.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search STAC items with bbox, datetime, and attribute filters.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Retrieve a specific STAC item and its assets.

tools.name: get_queryables
tools.description: Inspect supported queryable fields when the catalog exposes them.

tools.name: get_aggregations
tools.description: Request collection-level aggregations when supported by the catalog.

tools.name: estimate_data_size
tools.description: Estimate dataset size for matching STAC items before download.
